title: Royal Twisted — Spiral Keep
description: A 2–10 contestant obstacle-survival run around Spiral Keep: jump low cyan rods, duck high coral rods, survive up to seven hits, and race AI or remote-controlled rivals. v0.5 exposes CALLBACK remote-input hooks; the older v0.4 upload is retained as an archive.

source.provenance: Imported from the user-supplied royal_twisted_spiral_keep_v0.5_original_camera_knockback.html. The uploaded v0.4 ten-player build is retained separately under source/archive/ for history. The active build imports Three.js 0.180.0 from jsDelivr at runtime.
